scripts.test: npm run build-test && mocha --exit --require source-map-support/register --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=reports,reportFilename=autotest,overwrite=true,html=true,json=true dist/tests/**/*.test.js
scripts.devTest: npm run build-test && mocha --require source-map-support/register --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=reports,reportFilename=autotest,overwrite=true,html=true,json=true dist/tests/**/*.test.js
scripts.setup-local: pnpm -F autotest install --no-frozen-lockfile && pnpm -r --filter '@webspatial/*' run build && pnpm -F autotest run build
